sources.title: GitHub - gleis/terra-ai: Electron App to visualize Terraform config and ...
sources.snippet: Terra-AI is an Electron desktop app for exploring Terraform workspaces locally. It renders a dependency graph from terraform graph, lets you inspect resources visually, and sends the loaded Terraform context to a local Ollama model for questions and file-edit suggestions.

sources.title: OpenAI to launch GPT-5.6, its most advanced AI model yet, after delayed ...
sources.snippet: The GPT-5.6 lineup includes three models: Sol, Terra, and Luna. Sol is the flagship system and OpenAI's most capable model to date. Terra is pitched as a lower-cost option for everyday work, with performance that OpenAI says is competitive with GPT-5.5. Luna is the cheapest model in the series, aimed at users who need speed and lower costs.
